title: R' Yose ben Perata (a Tanna)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Nedarim 41a](https://www.sefaria.org/Nedarim.41a.10); he spoke in the name of R' Eliezer. Perhaps the text should read "ben Perida," who was a student of R' Eliezer.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Nedarim and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1921&lang=en) name Yose ben Perata speaking in Rabbi Eliezer’s name.
Hyman tentatively proposes Perida on the basis of the reported teacher–student relationship.
